The FloPlast rigid 90° angled pan connector provides a reliable plumbing solution for connecting toilet pans to soil pipes. Manufactured from durable white polypropylene, this robust pan connector is suitable for various bathroom installations. The 90° angle and 300mm length are ideal for specific space requirements, ensuring a neat and efficient toilet plumbing setup. Featuring a 100mm push-fit inlet and a 110mm push-fit outlet, installation is straightforward. An integral sealing diaphragm accommodates up to 5° of misalignment, ensuring a secure and watertight connection, making it an essential component for plumbers and renovators.
